title: Modern GEODATA DWG scale-method domain
scope: GEODATA object versions 2 and 3 accept scale-estimation method values 1 through 4 in DWG output. Invalid values fail before low-level body/string/handle buffers mutate and are rejected by dwgWriter15 before caller handle/class staging. Version 1 retains its distinct field map and accepts only default method 1, which is not serialized by that layout.

normativeSources.title: Autodesk GEODATA (DXF)
normativeSources.group95: 1 none; 2 user-specified scale factor; 3 grid scale at reference point; 4 prismoidal.

normativeSources.title: Open Design Alliance DbGeoData API reference
normativeSources.enum: ScaleEstimationMethod uses 1 for unity, then user-defined, reference-point and prismoidal methods in order.

normativeSources.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.78
normativeSources.scope: The GEODATA object body contains the scale-estimation method field; this change validates the field domain and does not change its byte layout.

implementation.behavior: DRW_GeoData::encodeDwg rejects invalid modern methods before writing to any supplied buffer. dwgWriter15::writeGeoData repeats the profile guard before common object-state preparation, handle allocation or class registration. DRW_GeoData defaults/reset use method 1.

regressionControl.coverage: For v2 and v3, values -1, 0 and 5 leave sentinel-prefilled body, string and handle buffers unchanged; the same object and buffers then encode successfully with valid boundary methods 1 or 4. The GEODATA CIVIL-tail target matrix continues to verify valid v1/v2/v3 encode/parse field alignment and typed readback.
regressionControl.fixturePolicy: All controls are authored locally in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

nonClaims: No physical producer or native geospatial consumer was qualified.
This does not qualify GEODATA ownership, whole-document graph closure, map projection behavior or DWG encoding semantics beyond the tested field domain and existing vector controls.
